corrections.why: The print has दारिद्र्य …॥ ending verse 2; the transcription lost the letters, the dots and the danda, and so ran verses 2 and 3 together.

split.why: The danda restored above ends verse 2 here.

variants.extra: गौरीविलासभवनाय महेश्वराय पञ्चाननाय शरणागतकल्पकाय शर्वाय सर्वजगतामधिपाय तस्मै दारिद्र्यदुःखदहनाय नमः शिवाय
variants.note: The witness has a further verse before this one; the book does not print it.

variants.reading: त्रिसन्ध्यं यः पठेन्नित्यं स हि स्वर्गमवाप्नुयात्
variants.note: A third line the book prints and the witness does not.
